title: Metronome Tempo Ceiling Growth
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prometronome:session tempo_bpm=* exercise_name=*
| timechart span=1mon max(tempo_bpm) as peak_tempo by exercise_name
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends the fastest clean practice tempo reached for each exercise over time.
value: Tempo ceiling is a simple and motivating proxy for technical fluency on repeated drills.
implementation: Capture the end tempo of each Pro Metronome session and trend the monthly peak per exercise.
visualization: Line chart of monthly peak BPM by exercise.
grandmaExplanation: It counts how your fastest comfortable practice speed is climbing over time.
